messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: GPU pool eu-west-1-prod-gpus saturation. queue_depth=2317, active_gpus=198/200, avg_token_latency=420ms. autoscaler_attempt=scale_up(4) -> FAIL (reason: scale_limit_reached).

pagerbot: Pager triggered for oncall group: infra-oncall (sam_oncall). Severity: P1.

sam_oncall: looking. I'm seeing a steady queue growth + lots of throttles (429s) in front of the pool. tagging infra and prod-eng.

sam_oncall: quick metrics dump:
```
queue_depth: 230 -> 2317 over 9m
gpu_util: 93% -> 99%
request_429_rate: 2.9% (eu-west-1)
autoscaler.log: attempt at 12:04: scale_up(4) -> error: quota_exceeded: regional_node_quota (limit 200 nodes)
```

maria_prodeng: fyi we pushed a batching/cache tweak in last rollout (small PR yesterday). It changed continuous_batch_window and prefix_cache_ttl. could be related.

liam_infra: checking autoscaler control plane logs now. I see repeated entries: `ProvisionTimeout` and `scale_limit_reached`. Also a warning about `worker_provision_rate` hitting soft cap.

maria_prodeng: config snippet from yesterday's deploy (intent was to reduce small-shot latency):
```
service.defaults.continuous_batching.enabled = true
service.defaults.continuous_batching.batch_window_ms = 120  # was 20
service.defaults.prefix_cache.ttl_seconds = 5          # was 60
```
This would increase batching aggregation but also cause cache churn if ttl too low. That mismatch can pump backend requests and hold KV locks longer.

nora_sre: if continuous batching is coalescing too aggressively after prefix cache misses, we could see lots of cache rehydrates -> more GPU work per logical request -> queues fill.

sam_oncall: agreed. initial plan for live mitigation (short list):
1) rollback continuous_batching.batch_window to 20ms OR temporarily disable continuous batching.
2) increase prefix_cache.ttl to 600s to reduce missstorm.
3) request emergency autoscaler quota bump / remove soft cap for eu-west-1 for next 30m (liam to own).
4) reroute non-critical EU traffic to us-west-2 if quick network failover is acceptable for customers.

liam_infra: I'll open an emergency quota request with cloud. ETA unknown (~10-25m). Meanwhile I can bump the autoscaler max_nodes for that pool to allow immediate scaling beyond the soft cap (manual override). Will do a quick patch.

maria_prodeng: to disable continuous batching quickly: patch via config API:
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  "https://config.redwood.internal/v1/services/eu-west-1/prod/patch" \
  -d '{"continuous_batching.enabled": false}'
```
or set batch_window_ms=20 if we prefer. I vote disable then re-evaluate.

sam_oncall: applying disable now. Pasting command I ran: `kubectl exec -it config-api-0 -- /bin/sh -c "apply-config --patch '{\"continuous_batching.enabled\":false}'"`

deploy-bot: deploy job accepted: config-patch/disable-cont-batch -> started.

pagerbot: @sam_oncall noted as responder.

julie_cs: customer impact report from CS dashboard: AtlasPayments (EU shard) seeing ~3% request failures for last 12m, avg retry latency +450ms, some merchants seeing timeouts. Notifying AE/CS.

nora_sre: sam, if you want me to take over handoff, I'm ready. I'm happy to coordinate with CS for customer comms and track mitigation progress.

sam_oncall: handing to nora_sre at 12:13. primary mitigation steps kicked off: disabled continuous batching, increasing prefix cache TTL to 600s (live patch). liam working on max_nodes bump.

liam_infra: patched autoscaler max_nodes=260 for eu-west-1-pool. cloud quota request still open but manual override in place.

maria_prodeng: increased prefix cache TTL via config API: `prefix_cache.ttl_seconds=600` (applied).

deploy-bot: config-patch finished: continuous_batching.enabled=false -> success.

sam_oncall: metrics ~5m after mitigations:
```
queue_depth: 2317 -> 610
gpu_util: 99% -> 86%
request_429_rate: 2.9% -> 0.4%
avg_token_latency: 420ms -> 210ms
```

julie_cs: CS update: AtlasPayments still had brief outage window but most traffic recovered after retries. We're drafting a post-incident note and customer outreach.

nora_sre: I'll keep this thread as primary. next steps:
- monitor for 30m and let autoscaler stabilize
- roll a targeted revert or smaller batch_window experiment (batch_window_ms=30) if safe
- follow up with prod-eng postmortem to discuss config default choices and gated rollout for batching/profile changes
- coordinate customer comms with julie_cs

nora_sre: handing to oncall rotation (nora_sre remains POC for incident). If anything regresses ping me @nora_sre immediately.

sam_oncall: thanks everyone. marking page acknowledged -> resolved for now.

pagerbot: Pager cleared (incident marked mitigated).
